headline: Air Security reports a Solana starter repository used to deliver a remote-access payload through coding-agent workflows
summary: Air Security Research Lab’s 29 October report describes a GitHub repository posing as a Solana starter kit whose README instructed users to run a PowerShell command that downloaded and executed code. The report says its recovered archived payload installed a configured NetSupport remote-access client with hidden operation and login persistence. Air Security reports that the original payload endpoint was offline when checked and the named repository was later unavailable. The report documents a plausible agent-mediated delivery route, but does not establish that a coding agent executed the command, identify victims, or measure campaign prevalence. the research desk did not independently inspect or run the sample.
